name: High-energy vertical reel
note: Social vertical. Short shots, strong motion, bright and saturated. Still not a cut on every beat -- the budget is large, not infinite, and it is spent where the song is loudest.

subject_note: Every brief names its world. Without one they all draw from the same pool, and two briefs differing only in pacing produced 94% the same cuts AND 95% the same shots -- which bench/cutscore.py --brief-swap caught.
